Frequently asked questions

Which purchases count as travel? Travel includes airlines, hotels, motels, timeshares, car rental agencies, cruise lines, travel agencies, discount travel sites, campgrounds, passenger trains, buses, taxis, limousines, ferries, toll bridges and highways, and parking lots and garages. Merchants are assigned codes by their payment processors, and those codes decide the category; purchases through third-party payment accounts or digital wallets may not count. How long does it take for points to post? Points are credited after the purchase posts to your account, usually within a few business days, and they appear on your monthly statement. Can I transfer points? Points transfer to participating airline and hotel loyalty programs at full value. Are there blackout dates? There are no blackout dates on travel booked through Chase Travel. What happens to my points if I close my account? Unredeemed points are forfeited when an account closes, so redeem them first. Is takeout included? Yes: dining at restaurants includes takeout and eligible delivery services. Is there a limit on points? There is no limit on the points you can earn with this card.
